news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Price Targets Cut by Stifel and Lake Street After Q2 Miss
news.summary: Following the Q2 revenue miss and lowered guidance, Stifel cut its price target to $22 from $25 and Lake Street cut its target to $25 from $30, while both firms kept Buy ratings. The cuts reflect updated near-term revenue and margin assumptions rather than a change in long-term thesis.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Outlines $500 Million Long-Term Revenue Target via Five-Pillar Strategy
news.summary: Alongside its Q2 results, ClearPoint presented a long-term roadmap targeting $500 million in annual revenue built around five pillars including cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain, robotics, and focused ultrasound. Investors weighed the ambitious long-term vision against near-term execution problems and rising cash burn.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Outlines $48M-$52M 2026 Revenue Guidance as It Prioritizes CAL, Clinical Capacity
news.summary: ClearPoint cut its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48 million-$52 million from a prior $52 million-$56 million range, citing a shift in priorities toward clinical case support, regulatory expansion, CAL capital equipment, and focused ultrasound/robotics development. The reduced outlook followed a Q2 revenue miss versus consensus.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: ClearPoint reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9 million, up 18% year-over-year but about $1.8 million below the $12.73 million consensus estimate, with a net loss of $11.3 million and EPS of -$0.38 versus -$0.29 expected. Shares fell as much as 15%-20% in after-hours and next-day trading on the miss and guidance cut.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Activates ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories, Signs First GLP Statement of Work
news.summary: The company confirmed its ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) preclinical facility in Torrey Pines is now in its possession and disclosed the first signed statement of work for a GLP IND-enabling study, expected to be performed in the first half of 2027. Management said new CAL services revenue should return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to growth in Q3.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro announced it would release Q2 2026 financial results after market close on August 3, 2026, with a conference call for investors and analysts the same afternoon. This scheduling notice set the stage for the earnings event that drove most of the company's news flow in early August.

catalysts.label: Partner uniQure files BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease
catalysts.detail: uniQure's Huntington's disease gene therapy AMT-130, delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and navigation platform, is planned for accelerated-approval BLA submission in Q3 2026 after FDA agreed the 3-year Phase I/II data could support the filing.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study performed at CAL facility
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's newly activated ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (Torrey Pines) is scheduled to perform its first signed GLP statement-of-work study for a biopharma partner in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: CE Mark decision for ClearPoint Prism Neuro Laser Therapy System
catalysts.detail: Partner Clinical Laserthermia Systems submitted a CE-marking application for the ClearPoint Prism-branded neuro laser therapy system, with European regulatory approval expected in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: ~10-15 partner clinical trials expected to enroll, ~10 data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management said its 60+ active biopharma partners are expected to have 10-15 clinical trials enrolling over the next 18 months, with roughly 10 data readouts anticipated using ClearPoint's delivery platform.

catalysts.label: Third-quarter 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's next quarterly results will show whether the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment returns to growth as guided and whether full-year revenue tracks toward the revised $48M-$52M guidance.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro delivered a mixed Q2 2026 (reported Aug 3): revenue grew 18% year-over-year to $10.9 million but missed consensus, prompting a cut to full-year guidance (to $48M-$52M) and a roughly 15-20% share-price plunge, with Stifel and Lake Street both trimming price targets days later. Cash fell to $29.4 million as operating expenses rose sharply, even as management unveiled a long-term $500 million five-pillar growth vision and highlighted progress at its new CAL preclinical facility. The stock trades well below its 52-week high near multi-month lows, with the bull case now resting on execution of that long-term platform story and on near-term catalysts like partner uniQure's planned Q3 2026 BLA filing for AMT-130, which relies on ClearPoint's delivery technology.
